description: This file defines the AuthCodeEntity class in the OrangeHRM OAuth plugin, implementing OAuth2 authorization code logic with methods for managing redirect URI, identifier, expiry time, user ID, client, and scopes.

classes.name: AuthCodeEntity
classes.description: Represents an OAuth2 authorization code entity, with methods to manage its properties such as redirect URI, identifier, expiry time, associated user, client, and scopes.

methods.name: getRedirectUri
methods.description: Returns the redirect URI associated with the auth code.

methods.name: setRedirectUri
methods.description: Sets the redirect URI for the auth code.

methods.name: getIdentifier
methods.description: Retrieves the unique identifier for the auth code.

methods.name: setIdentifier
methods.description: Sets the unique identifier for the auth code.

methods.name: getExpiryDateTime
methods.description: Returns the expiry DateTimeImmutable of the auth code.

methods.name: setExpiryDateTime
methods.description: Sets the expiry date/time of the auth code, overriding to UTC and adding TTL.

methods.name: getUserIdentifier
methods.description: Returns the user identifier associated with the auth code, if any.

methods.name: setUserIdentifier
methods.description: Sets the user identifier associated with the auth code.

methods.name: getClient
methods.description: Returns the client entity associated with the auth code.

methods.name: setClient
methods.description: Sets the client entity for the auth code.

methods.name: addScope
methods.description: Adds a scope to the auth code.

methods.name: getScopes
methods.description: Retrieves all scopes associated with the auth code.
